timestamp_authority: Concrete timestamps inside signed Grant validity are runtime authority; source duration/absolute policy values are provenance and issuance input.
current_t2_not_before_rule: not_before MUST equal issued_at as an instant. Delayed activation is deferred.

fixed_duration_resolution.grammar: P<n>D | P<n>M | P<n>Y where n is a positive integer
fixed_duration_resolution.P<n>D: add n calendar days to not_before in UTC
fixed_duration_resolution.P<n>M: add n calendar months, preserve UTC time-of-day, clamp invalid day-of-month to last valid day of target month
fixed_duration_resolution.P<n>Y: add n calendar years, preserve UTC time-of-day, clamp invalid day-of-month to last valid day of target month
fixed_duration_resolution.emit: concrete expires_at RFC3339 date-time; issuer SHOULD emit normalized UTC Z form

absolute_expiry_resolution: expires_at is the policy absolute_expires_at instant; it MUST be strictly later than not_before.
copy_export_import: Never recalculate issued_at, not_before or expires_at.
